self_test_correction.issue: The synthetic design assigned one PSU per stratum because the stratum and PSU repetition periods were aliased.
self_test_correction.fix: The synthetic grid now explicitly crosses cycle, six strata, and two PSUs and verifies two PSUs per stratum before conversion.

quantile_extraction_correction.issue: Current survey::svyquantile returns a newsvyquantile list, which cannot be coerced directly with as.numeric().
quantile_extraction_correction.fix: Extract point quantiles with coef(), validate the four support rows, and test this path in the R installation self-test.

interaction_validator_correction.issue: The public validator treated any comma in str(term_features_) as evidence of an interaction. Python singleton tuples such as (0,) contain a grammatical comma even though they contain one feature.
interaction_validator_correction.fix: Public term output now records explicit feature names, pipe-delimited indices, and term_feature_count. Interaction validation requires term_feature_count == 1 and exact index/name mapping.
